question: An administrator is configuring Erasure Coding on a Redundancy Factor 2 cluster. How many nodes, at a minimum, are necessary? A. 3 B. 4 C. 5 D. 6
discussion: Selected Answer: B ChadGPT: Erasure Coding (EC) in Nutanix requires more nodes than simple replication because data is striped across nodes with parity blocks for fault tolerance. In a Redundancy Factor 2 (RF2) cluster, the cluster can tolerate one node failure. For Erasure Coding with RF2, Nutanix requires a minimum of 4 nodes. With fewer than 4 nodes, the system cannot properly distribute data and parity blocks while still maintaining resiliency. The 4-node minimum ensures there are enough nodes to hold the data stripes and parity information across the cluster. upvoted 2 times Submit Cancel

Selected Answer: B A cluster must have at least four nodes/blocks/racks to enable erasure coding. The cluster can have all four flash nodes or a combination of flash and hybrid nodes, or all hybrid nodes. If erasure coding is enabled on a storage container, a minimum of four blocks for RF2 or six blocks for RF3 is required to maintain block awareness. check this link: https://portal.nutanix.com/page/documents/details?targetId=Prism-Central-Guide-vpc_2024_2:wc-erasure-coding-best-practices-requirements-wc-c.html upvoted 2 times Submit Cancel

question: Which storage container option reduces the available storage to other containers? A. Advertised Capacity B. Erasure Coding C. Capacity Deduplication D. Reserved Capacity
discussion: Selected Answer: D Capacity reservation allows you to guarantee that a storage container has a minimum amount reserved that is unavailable to other storage containers. By default, each storage container has access to all of the unused storage in the storage pool. If a storage pool consists of multiple storage containers, one storage container might take all the remaining storage space and leave others with no available space. To make sure that there is space available for a storage container, you can enable capacity reservation upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: An administrator is conducting updates in a Nutanix cluster and is being prompted for handling non-migratable VMs. Which VM type is non-migratable? A. VMs without NGT B. VMs marked as an Agent C. Memory Overcommitted VMs D. VMs with attached Volume Groups
discussion: Selected Answer: D VMs with attached Volume Groups are considered non-migratable during Nutanix cluster updates because they utilize direct-attached iSCSI storage, which is pinned to a specific host and cannot be live-migrated.Why: These VMs connect directly to Volume Groups (block storage) using iSCSI, which bypasses the standard AHV live-migration mechanism.Result: When an administrator puts a node into maintenance mode, VMs with attached Volume Groups must be shut down, or the upgrade cannot proceed automatically. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
Selected Answer: D Not migrated” ≠ “Non-migratable VM type (in LCM prompt context) upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
Answer is B upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

Selected Answer: D In a Nutanix cluster, Volume Groups provide block storage to VMs, similar to how physical disks work. VMs that have Volume Groups attached cannot be live-migrated because the block device is tied to a specific host and does not support migration like virtual disks on shared storage. Here’s why the other options are not correct: A. VMs without NGT: Nutanix Guest Tools (NGT) are optional and do not affect VM migration. B. VMs marked as an Agent: Being marked as an agent does not prevent migration. C. Memory Overcommitted VMs: Overcommitted memory might affect performance but does not make a VM non-migratable. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

In Nutanix, VMs marked as an agent are not migrated to another host in the cluster. If an HA event occurs or the host is put in maintenance mode, the agent VMs are powered off and powered on on the same host once that host comes back to a normal state. They are never migrated back to the original host https://portal.nutanix.com/page/documents/kbs/details?targetId=kA032000000CmlyCAC upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
